description: A synchronous, non-bypassing, lossless ready/valid queue carrying DATA_WIDTH payload bits, LAST and USER. Capacity is 2**ADDR_WIDTH words.
reset: Active-high synchronous reset flushes all accepted but unconsumed words at each rising edge. While reset is asserted, s_ready and m_valid are zero. The first four directed cycles assert reset.
handshake: Outside reset a transfer occurs on a rising edge when valid and ready are both high. The source must hold valid and its data/sidebands while stalled, unless reset is asserted. The receiver may stop for any number of cycles.
availability: m_valid is high exactly when buffered words exist. The head data and sidebands remain stable while stalled. No direct input-to-output bypass is allowed.
ready: s_ready must be high exactly when reset is low and either there is unused capacity or an existing head word will be consumed on this edge. Full-capacity simultaneous dequeue/enqueue must be supported.
ordering: Each accepted word, including LAST and USER, appears once and in order unless flushed by reset. New traffic must work after reset; tying off ready or valid cannot satisfy the contract.
parameters: Directed checks use DATA_WIDTH=8 and ADDR_WIDTH in {1,2,3}; formal checks will use listed fixed profiles only. This is not an all-parameter or unbounded proof.
